== Reward == {{Gear Set |Shining Helm |Shining Breastplate |Shining Vambraces |Shining Bracer |Shining Gauntlets |Shining Greaves |Shining Boots }} == Checklist == Turn-ins to [[Barlek Stonefist]] in [[Kael Drakkal]].{{CheckboxList}} *[[Shining Helm]] :*[[Ancient Tarnished Plate Helmet]] :*3x [[Crushed Coral]] *[[Shining Breastplate]] :*[[Ancient Tarnished Breastplate]] :*3x [[Flawless Diamond]] *[[Shining Vambraces]] :*[[Ancient Tarnished Vambraces]] :*3x [[Flawed Emerald]] *[[Shining Bracer]] :*[[Ancient Tarnished Plate Bracelet]] :*3x [[Crushed Flame Emerald]] *[[Shining Gauntlets]] :*[[Ancient Tarnished Plate Gauntlets]] :*3x [[Crushed Topaz]] *[[Shining Greaves]] :*[[Ancient Tarnished Greaves]] :*3x [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]] *[[Shining Boots]] :*[[Ancient Tarnished Plate Boots]] :*3x [[Crushed Black Marble]] {{End}} == Walkthrough == ''Intro dialogue needed.'' After handing in your items: Barlek Stonefist smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'
* Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[King Tormax (Faction)|King Tormax]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Claws of Veeshan]] got worse.
== Helm == ''Dialogue needed.'' Barlek promises to make you a helm if you bring him an [[Ancient Tarnished Plate Helmet]] and three pieces of [[Crushed Coral]]. == Breastplate == ''Dialogue needed.'' Barlek promises to make you a breastplate if you bring him an [[Ancient Tarnished Breastplate]] and three [[Flawless Diamond]]s. == Armplates == ''Dialogue needed.'' Barlek promises to make you some armplates if you bring him a pair of [[Ancient Tarnished Vambraces]] and three [[Flawed Emerald]]s. == Bracer == ''Dialogue needed.'' Barlek promises to make you some bracers if you bring him an [[Ancient Tarnished Plate Bracelet]] and three [[Crushed Flame Emerald]]s. == Gauntlets == ''Dialogue needed.'' Barlek promises to make you some gauntlets if you bring him a pair of [[Ancient Tarnished Plate Gauntlets]] as well as three [[Crushed Topaz]]. == Greaves == ''Dialogue needed.'' Barlek promises to make you some greaves if you bring him a pair of [[Ancient Tarnished Greaves]] and three [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]]s. == Boots == ''Dialogue needed.'' Barlek promises to make you some boots if you bring him a pair of [[Ancient Tarnished Plate Boots]] and a set of three [[Crushed Black Marble]] pieces.
